purpose: Authoritative visual identity and rendering constraints for Riven and Deathbound scenes.

global_target.description: Believable real-human cinematic realism with controlled stylization for a mature supernatural animated drama.
global_target.visual_formula: real human foundation + cinematic photography language + restrained animation stylization + supernatural art direction

riven.identity_lock: same person across every video, shot, pose and environment
riven.skin: pale/slightly desaturated with natural texture and minor imperfections

hair.construction: natural clumps and strands, no exaggerated anime spikes

wardrobe.outer: charcoal-black hooded coat or understated black hooded outer layer

supernatural_state.power_activation: controlled supernatural eye glow and environmental effects only when causally justified

rendering.fabric_response: physically believable folds and matte response
rendering.lighting: cinematic motivated lighting, controlled highlights, atmospheric depth
rendering.camera: cinematic lens language, natural perspective, intentional depth of field
rendering.environment: ordinary contemporary American locations before supernatural intrusion
rendering.color: dark neutral palette with restrained warm/cool contrast
rendering.stylization: subtle and deliberate; never visibly anime or game-like
rendering.film_language: premium cinematic drama, not stock AI portrait

reference_policy.reference_framing: half-bust or chest-up, face unobstructed, hair and ears visible
reference_policy.reference_count: one primary identity reference plus optional controlled angle references

pass_target: supernatural elements remain controlled and causal
